work_item: W106 independent W101 material grammar and controller-route review

failures.text: On the roof, raise the clearcoat channel 20 points.
failures.observed: clarify / zero queue: 'Name one channel, one exact part, and a relative change in points.'
failures.assessment: Safe but misses the frozen alternate word order; the parser expects a verb-first command shape and does not consume this target-first phrasing.

failures.text: Shift roof clearcoat up by 20 points.
failures.observed: clarify / zero queue: 'Name one channel, one exact part, and a relative change in points.'
failures.assessment: Safe but 'shift ... up' is not a recognized explicit relative verb form.

failures.text: How do I increase clearcoat on the roof by 20 points?
failures.observed: Controller returns an edit clarification ('To request an edit, name one material channel and part...'), zero queue.
failures.assessment: The parser delegates this question, but offlineMaterialPlan converts it to an edit clarification. The pinned self-help classifier returns generic how_do_i without W66/W74, so offlineAsk does not hand it to the help answer. It is safe but does not answer the question.

safe_positive_edits.route: one exact edit_zone queue; only B/clearcoat changed; metal and roughness preserved
one exact edit_zone queue; only B/clearcoat changed; metal and roughness preserved

results.safe_fallbacks: Missing/unitless amounts, spelled-out amounts, percent values, negative amounts, conflicting/multiple actions, absolute set requests, mixed incomplete channels, unsupported target, and metallic-plus-points all clarify with zero queued edits. Bare 'Make the roof metallic' is delegated by material controls and offlineMaterialPlan returns null, leaving the normal look/finish planner available.
results.passive_help: 'What does the clearcoat channel do?' bypasses material editing and reaches the actual pinned self-help route with zero queue. The answer gives adjustment steps and cautions about the B/COAT offset but does not directly define what the channel does.

tests.execution: 16 actual parser/controller-route cases replayed. Expected grammar-gap cases return process exit 1; all 16 have zero provider/native/server/paint-application effects.
limits: Uses actual candidate parser/build APIs and actual offlineMaterialPlan/offlineMaterialAsk/offlineAsk/selfHelpResult function bodies in a VM. Current zone owner, operation ticket, warmup, rendering, and edit_zone are controlled test fixtures.
The edit sink captures actual queued arguments; it does not execute the paint application, verify pixels, call a native app, provider, or server. Root owns those acceptance checks.
Bare metallic was verified to leave material ownership (plan=null); the downstream ordinary finish planner was not executed in this test.
